spec.doc: Deprecated no-op, kept so existing callers and bindings keep working: acknowledging is no longer a separate step. Use `resume_agents`.
spec.name: acknowledge_drawdown

spec.doc: Buys with a prior decision-bearing trace consumed atomically.
spec.name: agent_buy_traced

spec.doc: Sells with a prior decision-bearing trace consumed atomically.
spec.name: agent_sell_traced

spec.doc: Whether `op` is permitted in the current mode: the gate's answer, for agents and frontends to pre-check.
spec.name: allowed

spec.doc: Declares an emergency: opens `emergency_withdraw` (the idle-only, position-forfeiting exit) and closes new withdrawal requests. Only from `AdminPaused`, so one admin call cannot flip straight into the forfeiting exit; with the timelock as admin the extra step is delayed too.
spec.name: declare_emergency

spec.doc: `Mode::Emergency` only (`declare_emergency`, itself only from an admin pause): burns `shares` for their pro-rata part of the free idle collateral, without reading market-core (for when it is the thing that broke). The owner forfeits their part of open positions, which stays with the remaining shareholders. A drawdown halt or an ordinary admin pause never opens it: the normal queued exit pays at NAV (ADR 0005).
spec.name: emergency_withdraw

spec.doc: Ends the emergency. The admin pause stands (`AdminPaused`); `unpause` then resumes. In production route it through `timelock.schedule`.
spec.name: end_emergency

spec.doc: Applies the pending resolvability policy once its delay has passed. Permissionless.
spec.name: execute_resolvability_policy

spec.doc: The effective operating mode.
spec.name: mode

spec.doc: Each stored reason (drawdown halt, admin pause, emergency) with when it began and, for the admin's, why.
spec.name: mode_state

spec.doc: Admin pause: no deposits and no agent trading (settlement, queued withdrawals and recalls stay open). Idempotent.
spec.name: pause

spec.doc: Redeems the treasury's position in a resolved/voided market (`ROLE_SETTLE`).
spec.name: redeem

spec.doc: Clears a drawdown halt. Allowed only once the realized window PnL is back above `-max_drawdown` (waiting for old losses to leave the window, or an explicit `reset_pnl_window`), so an admin cannot simply wave a real loss through. Leaves any admin pause or emergency untouched. Replaces `acknowledge_drawdown` + `set_paused(false)`.
spec.name: resume_agents

spec.doc: Lengthens the timelock. Shortening is refused outright: it would itself have to wait out the old delay to be safe, and a lengthening can always be undone by redeploying.
spec.name: set_config_delay

spec.doc: Admin mode transition kept from #150: `Normal` clears an admin pause and an unwind (a drawdown halt stands: `resume_agents`), `Paused` is `pause`, `Unwinding` replaces an admin pause with an orderly wind-down. `Emergency` and `AgentsHalted` have their own entrypoints (`declare_emergency`, the drawdown trip) and are refused here.
spec.name: set_mode

spec.doc: `set_paused(true)` is `pause(admin)`, `set_paused(false)` is `unpause()`. Kept for the timelock's emergency path (ADR 0008), which calls `set_paused(true)`.
spec.name: set_paused

spec.doc: Admin only. Tightening (a flag to `true`, a larger `min_secs_to_close`, fewer `allowed_specs` bits) applies at once; anything that loosens a knob waits `config_delay` (`execute_resolvability_policy`).
spec.name: set_resolvability_policy

spec.doc: Clears the admin pause only. A drawdown halt, if any, stands, so the agents stay halted; clear it with `resume_agents`. Refused while an emergency is declared (`end_emergency` first).
spec.name: unpause

void_v0.doc: A drawdown tripped: agents may not open or add exposure, but may reduce it. Depositors keep their normal exit (queued withdrawals at NAV).
void_v0.name: AgentsHalted

void_v0.doc: The admin declared an emergency (only from `Paused`): the in-kind/idle `emergency_withdraw` exit opens, and queueing new withdrawals closes.
void_v0.name: Emergency

void_v0.doc: The admin paused the treasury: no deposits and no agent trading.
void_v0.name: Paused

void_v0.doc: The admin chose an orderly wind-down (`set_mode(Unwinding)`, #150): agents may not open or add exposure, but may sell (see `unwind_sell` and the per-market exit floors), and everything else runs as in `Normal`.
void_v0.name: Unwinding

spec.doc: What the treasury is doing right now, derived from [`ModeState`] with the priority `Emergency > Paused > AgentsHalted > Unwinding > Normal`.
spec.name: Mode

spec.doc: Why the treasury is not in `Normal`. Each reason is stored independently, so clearing one never clears another.

fields.doc: Ledger time of the admin pause. Cleared by `unpause` / `set_paused(false)`.
fields.name: admin_pause_at

fields.doc: The reason the admin gave (`admin` for `set_paused(true)`; `legacy` for a pause read from the pre-#272 flags). Set with `admin_pause_at`.
fields.name: admin_pause_reason

fields.doc: Ledger time a drawdown halted the agents. Cleared by `resume_agents`.
fields.name: drawdown_halt

fields.doc: Ledger time the admin declared an emergency. Cleared by `end_emergency`.
fields.name: emergency_at

fields.doc: The reason the admin gave. Set with `emergency_at`.
fields.name: emergency_reason

fields.doc: Ledger time the admin set `Unwinding`. Cleared by `set_mode(Normal)`.
fields.name: unwinding_at

spec.name: ModeState

void_v0.doc: `agent_create_market`, `agent_create_market_and_reveal`, `agent_buy`, `agent_buy_v2`: anything that opens or adds exposure.
void_v0.name: AgentOpen

void_v0.doc: `redeem`, `claim_pool_remainder`, the batch variants and `agent_claim_lp_fees`: bringing collateral home after resolution.
void_v0.name: AgentSettle

spec.doc: A class of state-changing entrypoint. Every one the treasury exposes maps to exactly one `Op` (or is pure admin configuration, which is never gated; see the `matrix` test in `lib.rs`).
spec.name: Op

spec.doc: Pre-trade resolvability policy for `agent_buy` / `agent_buy_v2` (#273): the treasury will not put depositor capital into a market that cannot be resolved, whatever the agent believes. Sells, redemptions and settlement are never gated by it (the treasury must always be able to exit or settle). Tightening is immediate (a flag set to `true`, a larger `min_secs_to_close`, fewer `allowed_specs` bits); everything else waits `config_delay`, like the other policies. The default is fully permissive, so an upgraded deployment behaves as before until the admin tightens it.

fields.doc: Bitmask over `resolver::SpecKind`: kinds that may be bought into.
fields.name: allowed_specs

fields.doc: No buys while the resolver reports `Disputed` (finalization frozen).
fields.name: block_when_disputed

fields.doc: No buys while a signer proposal is pending. Off by default: opening a proposal needs a signer, but a quorum can still use it to freeze buys.
fields.name: block_with_open_proposal

fields.doc: Minimum seconds between now and `close_time` for a buy (0 = none). Does not apply to seed-and-reveal creation, which happens far from close.
fields.name: min_secs_to_close

fields.doc: The market's resolution spec must have been revealed to its resolver.
fields.name: require_revealed

spec.name: ResolvabilityPolicy

spec.doc: Collateral still owed to `owner` for shares already burned.
spec.name: WithdrawTicket

cases.doc: The treasury is in `Mode::Emergency`: only settlement, claiming existing withdrawal tickets and `emergency_withdraw` are open (#272).
cases.name: EmergencyMode

cases.doc: The market is `Disputed`: finalization is frozen (#273).
cases.name: MarketDisputed

cases.doc: `resume_agents`: the realized window PnL has not recovered above `-max_drawdown` (reset the window or wait for old losses to expire) (#272).
cases.name: NotRecovered

cases.doc: Past `close_time + RESOLUTION_GRACE_SECS`: the market can already be voided (#273).
cases.name: PastResolutionDeadline

cases.doc: A signer proposal is pending and the policy blocks buys then (#273).
cases.name: ProposalOpen

cases.doc: A call to the resolver failed (#273).
cases.name: ResolverCallFailed

cases.doc: The market's spec kind is not in `allowed_specs` (#273).
cases.name: SpecKindNotAllowed

cases.doc: The market's resolution spec was never revealed to its resolver, or a resolver accepted `register_spec_v2` and stored nothing (#273).
cases.name: SpecNotRevealed

spec.doc: Every change to the operating mode's reasons (#272). `from`/`to` are the effective modes; they are equal when a reason was added or cleared under a higher-priority one (e.g. a drawdown trips while the admin pause stands).
spec.name: ModeChanged

params.doc: `drawdown`, `resume`, `admin`, `unpause`, `legacy`, `emergency`, `end_emerg`, or the admin's own reason for `pause` / `declare_emergency`.
params.name: reason
